data.one_liner: A customizable animated side drawer for Flutter with controller, gesture, RTL, and multi-platform support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a dependency-free animated side drawer widget and controller for Flutter apps. Supports gestures, pinned or centered menus, page history, right-side drawers, and RTL layouts.
use_when: You need a custom animated side navigation menu that goes beyond standard Scaffold drawers.
You require RTL layout support or right-side drawer positioning.
You want optional page history and back-button handling built into the drawer controller.
avoid_when: You prefer using standard Material Scaffold drawers without external custom transitions.
Your navigation relies heavily on complex nested Navigator routing stacks managed entirely externally.
strengths: Dependency-free implementation with broad platform support.
Includes gesture support, edge dragging, and RTL layout awareness.
Provides optional page history and reactive controller updates.
weaknesses: Swaps page widgets instead of pushing native Navigator routes by default.
Requires managing a custom controller or state structure.
